BiblicalUsage: Nahbi is one of the twelve spies, named once in the list of the men Moses sent. In Numbers 13:14 he stands as Nahbi the son of Vophsi, of the tribe of Naphtali, sent to search the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the spies are remembered by name because the mission mattered, even when ten of them failed it. Nahbi went, and his name is on the list.
